Real implementations combine AIOps pipelines with engineering knowledge graphs. It proposes the next most-informative test. Defensive engineering use only.

title: Autonomous Failure Investigation System — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Autonomous Failure Investigation System — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Correlates logs, sensor data, and tests to find probable failure causes.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Autonomous Failure Investigation System, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Multi-source evidence ingestion). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Multi-source evidence ingestion and Causal hypothesis generation and ranking. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Root-cause and fault-correlation engine) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
